evidence_checks.claim: Brew ratio is derived from measured dose and output. TDS, EY and subjective quality are distinct; time often reflects coupled hydraulic outcome rather than an independent quality target.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js baseline and nextAdvice treat measured time as feedback, not standalone taste success

evidence_checks.source: PDF-SLOW-FEED pp1-10; Kaffeemacher 2025 original study; Smrke et al Scientific Reports 2024
evidence_checks.claim: Slow feeding can reduce fines at unchanged burr setting on tested DF64 grinders and speed shot. No universal percentage offset or sensory superiority follows.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js grindGuidance matches feed mode; only unproven 40% prior when better matching history absent

evidence_checks.claim: Do not average raw/normalized grind settings from differing feed modes. Successful recipe ratios from both modes may still provide qualified coffee-level context.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js grindGuidance requires matching feedMode; chooseRecipeFamily ranks matching feed condition but may reuse non-grind ratio

evidence_checks.claim: Proposals for grinder step size, advanced feed profiles and optional feed duration are historical research suggestions.
evidence_checks.locked: Master Spec 13.5 Oct28 explicitly rejects stepped/stepless control, tick-size feature and new grinder schema; Oct26 retires equipment version-management UI

evidence_checks.claim: Apas baseline x50 250um/fines 33.0%; manual slow-feed same setting 299um/23.9%; experiment on DF64 with differences across coffee/feed method.
Increasing added fines reduced puck permeability/flow and lengthened shot time under their controlled experimental conditions.
2026 espresso poroelastic pressure response study appears as published Physics of Fluids paper per June2026 article and DOI; full publisher paper not read.
Dose and beverage yield are independent measured controls; brew ratio, time, EY and TDS are derived observations. EY≈yield×TDS/dose is a mass balance, not a taste rating.
evidence_checks.grade: PHYSICAL_DEFINITION_CORRECT; RESEARCH DERIVED; NO INDEPENDENT FULL-CITATION AUDIT
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/model.js validateShot stores doseG/yieldG/timeS separately and requires five complete taste scales; site/lib/engine.js does not claim measured EY/TDS absent refractometer

evidence_checks.claim: Grind affects particle area and hydraulic resistance; over-fine may worsen evenness. Pressure/flow are machine-regime-dependent. No universal 9bar, 1:2, 25-30seconds, ideal EY, WDT or prep ranking supports sensory prescriptions.
evidence_checks.current_app: site/lib/engine.js nextAdvice uses taste and style-/setup-dependent time as a conditional cue, not a standalone success veto; five active styles; existing dose, grinder calibration and feed-mode gates

evidence_checks.claim: Wadsworth 2026 peer-reviewed university abstract supports connected pore volume/specific-surface model validated on two roasted coffees and 11 grinds. Waszkiewicz 2026 abstract supports nonlinear pressure-flow and dissolution, but no uniform sensory optima. External abstracts alone do not establish every numeric figure or causal sentence in original #07.
evidence_checks.current_app: App lacks pressure/flow/PSD/refractometer readings and owner-retired advanced hardware versioning. Resist adding unsupported new onboarding fields and profile heuristics.
